newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse postpones newcomer Aeroteh.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse postpones newcomer Aeroteh.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Thursday it has postponed a decision to allow local state-run aircraft maker Aeroteh SA to join bourse trading pending completion of checks on company data.
A bourse official said they were checking the shareholder list issued by Bucharest-based Aeroteh, and that the exchange would soon announce a date for the newcomer to start trading.
Aeroteh has a capital of 17.42 billion lei in 697,140 shares with a face value of 25,000 lei each.
Its majority stockholder is the State Owernship Fund (FPS) with a 70 percent stake. Private stockholders hold 27.4 percent, and 2.6 percent is held by employees.
Aeroteh was included in a 1995 mass selloff scheme offering Romanians stakes of up to 60 percent in 4,000 companies in exchange for coupons.
So far 23 stocks are traded on the bourse' second tier, with another two companies listed on the top tier. -- Andrei Iva, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264 REUTER
